page-title.purpose: Two stacked yellow lines in the header.

hero-number.purpose: Current temperature; the single big number on a page.

shadows.name: cg-drop
shadows.purpose: Hard character-generator shadow on all text except the ticker label.

components.name: Channel row
components.description: Focused row in a channel list.
components.css: .z-row{font-family:'Jersey 15',monospace;background:#3D4FC4;color:#FFE14D;font-size:28px;padding:12px 14px;border-top:3px solid #8593EE;border-left:3px solid #8593EE;border-bottom:3px solid #12175A;border-right:3px solid #12175A;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #0A0C30}.z-row i{font-style:normal;color:#F4F1E6;font-size:18px;float:right}.z-arrow{display:inline-block;width:0;height:0;border-top:7px solid transparent;border-bottom:7px solid transparent;border-left:8px solid #FFE14D;margin-right:8px}

components.name: Ticker
components.description: Bottom crawl with the yellow label.
components.html: ZENO GOOD EVENING, JAMES • BOSTON 48° CLOUDY •

narrative.overview: Every screen is one page of a 1990s cable information channel broadcasting from a sunset, with Zeno as the station mascot. Flat bevelled panels, one pixel face, hard shadows, stepped motion.
keyCharacteristics: One pixel face with hard drop shadow

rules.name: One data colour
rules.body: Charts use yellow on a bevel-dark track with direct labels.

rules.name: Bevels are the only edges
rules.body: Light top-left, dark bottom-right; no blur shadows.

rules.name: No eyebrows
rules.body: Titles are two stacked lines; nothing sits above them.
